input.subject: This Weekend Only: Our Weekend Sale at the Coffee Shop!
input.body:
Hi coffee lovers,

We're excited to announce our Weekend Sale! This Saturday and Sunday, stop by for special deals on your favorite drinks, fresh pastries, and bags of our freshly roasted beans.

What to expect:
- Special pricing on handcrafted espresso drinks and brewed coffee
- Deals on baked goods and pastries
- Discounts on whole-bean coffee to take home

Bring a friend, grab your favorite cup, and enjoy the weekend with us. The sale runs while supplies last, so come early!

See you soon,
The Team

P.S. Know someone who loves coffee? Forward this email and share the deal.
